jobs_results.title: .NET Developer
jobs_results.description:
En Rastreator, el bróker online de seguros y el comparador líder en España, nos centramos en asesorar y aconsejar a nuestros clientes para que elijan las mejores ofertas en seguros, hipotecas, telefonía, energía y otros productos, con precios garantizados y ofertas exclusivas.

Nuestra misión es ayudar a las personas para que tomen las mejores decisiones brindándoles una excelente experiencia de usuario. Y todo esto es gracias al trabajo entre equipos, la gran colaboración entre departamentos y la calidad humana de nuestros empleados.

Combinamos el trabajo de un entorno ágil y dinámico buscando la constante innovación como en una startup, con el know-how y la tecnología de una empresa consolidada. Y compartimos la pasión que te hace poner todo el esfuerzo en cada cosa que haces, día tras día, para seguir construyendo una empresa que sea un referente.

Somos un equipo inclusivo, en el que valoramos la igualdad de oportunidades y apostamos por el crecimiento personal y... profesional.

Actualmente nos encontramos en la búsqueda de un/a .NET Developer para unirse a nuestro equipo de desarrollo.

Tus funciones principales serán las siguientes:
• Desarrollarás código y realizarás integraciones.
• Las buenas prácticas son un must. En tu día a día implementarás tests para garantizar la calidad del producto.
• Tendrás ownership de tus desarrollos y entregarás nuevas funcionalidades y actualizaciones.
• Serás parte importante del equipo y participarás en las ceremonias de gestión: planning, dailies, retro, demos, etc.

Qué necesitamos de ti:
• Nivel de inglés que permita mantener conversaciones (reuniones diarias con equipo internacional).
• Experiencia en .NET Core y Angular.
• Conocimiento Azure Services y Azure DevOps.

Qué te ofrecemos:
• Salario Fijo + Variable + Bonus.
• Modelo de trabajo híbrido.
• Horario flexible y jornada intensiva los viernes y en verano.
• 25 días de vacaciones. Adicionalmente tendrás la opción de comprar 5 días extra.
• El día de tu cumpleaños tendrás un permiso de 3 horas.
• Paquete de retribución flexible (restaurante, transporte y guardería).
• Seguro médico para ti y tu familia, seguro de vida y Plan de Bienestar (Membresía Plataforma Urban Sport Club, App de contenido saludable, Iniciativas que fomentan la actividad física y la nutrición saludable, Plataformas de descuentos y mucho más...).
• Acceso a plataformas de E-Learning.
• 5 días extra de vacaciones pagados para participación en voluntariado/proyectos solidarios.
• Actividades disruptivas periódicas, Day off y fiesta en Navidad.
• Oficina pet friendly.
• Un equipo humano diverso con el que disfrutarás aprendiendo y trabajando.
• Excelente ambiente de trabajo - Empresa Great Place to Work

They should have experience in designing, coding, testing and consistently managing applications They should be comfortable coding in a number of languages and have an ability to test code in order to maintain high-quality code.

Responsibilities
• Design, code, test and manage various applications
• Collaborate with engineering team and product team to establish best products
• Follow outlined standards of quality related to code and systems
• Develop automated tests and conduct performance tuning

Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or relevant field
• 4+ years of experience working with .NET or relevant experiences
• Experience developing web-based applications in C#, HTML, JavaScript, VBScript/ASP, or .NET
• Experience working with MS SQL Server and MySQL Knowledge of practices and procedures for full software design life cycle
• Experience working in agile development environment

jobs_results.description: ADO.NET, Model-View-Controller, Microsoft Windows, Frontend, SQL, ASP.NET, IT, JavaScript, Angular, T-SQL, Anwendungsentwicklung, Relationale Datenbanken, Softwareentwicklung, Application Programming Interfaces, Backend, Datenbanken, C#, TCP/IP, Implementierung, Entity Framework, SAP, Microsoft SQL Server, Scrum, Windows Presentation Foundation, .NET (Senior) Software Developer - Full-Stack (m/f/d) Skills Full-Stack frontend backend Software development development C# .NET ASP.NET Angular MVC Web API WebForms WinForms WPF JavaScript SQL Relational database RDBMS ADO.NET Entity Framework EF T-SQL Windows Salary band 60,000 - 85,000 EUR About your LPA team We are a leading global developer, provider and advisor of technology-based capital market solutions for banks, insurance companies and fund providers. Become a part of our vision and dive into the world of technology and innovation in the financial sector! Our award-winning products and services help our clients to automate and... digitize regulatory required documentation and reporting processes, minimize risks and thus increase their efficiency with full compliance. As a passionate full-stack developer (m/f/d) with experience in the Windows world, you will work, sometimes remotely, together with our experts at the Frankfurt office both on the development of new applications and on the further development of existing software solutions. Your tasks Development of innovative applications, from prototyping to implementation of new products Further development of our software products for the capital market business Analyzing complex requirements and developing solutions in collaboration with highly motivated colleagues within and outside our cross-functional Scrum teams Evaluating and introducing new technologies and concepts Clarification of technical issues and creation of IT concepts - with and for our customers In addition to this product-centered work, you will work in a team to continuously improve and automate development and deployment processes. Your entry ticket You have several years of professional experience in application development - at least 10 years, ideally even 15 years Your experience is characterized by leading roles in the design of system subcomponents as well as in the migration and optimization of legacy systems You have extensive experience in the practical application of C#, .NET, ASP.NET, MVC & Web API, Angular, Web and Win Forms, WPF, JavaScript - preferably in agile projects - with A good understanding of databases - e.g. SQL Server RDBMS, ADO. NET & Entity Framework, T-SQL, etc. - is a given for you You are familiar with the principles relevant to the development of distributed software systems You are familiar with the development of rich and web clients, the design of larger data models and know how to design interfaces for integration A very good understanding of the basics of computer architectures, network topologies and protocols such as TCP/IP and HTTP complete your profile Experience in large customer projects is desirable - e.g. with 3rd party systems such as Calypso, Murex, SAP, including customer support and escalation Our features Software meets consulting: an established and growing company with start-up flair and flat hierarchies right up to the executive level A flexible working time model (including the option to work mobile 3 days a week) and workation A team-oriented, humorous working environment that is characterized by cohesion and offers you exciting tasks every day An office in the heart of Frankfurt with excellent public transport connections A wide range of further training opportunities Regular employee events and a flat rate of coffee, soft drinks and fruit Your contact person We look forward to receiving your application, which you should send to ******! If you have any questions, please contact Christian Baum on +49 69 9714850. We value diversity and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic and social background, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity

jobs_results.title: DESARROLLADOR FULL STACK (.Net)
jobs_results.description:
Si quieres formar parte de una compañía líder en su sector, crear proyectos innovadores y hacer que las cosas pasen, GILMAR es para ti.

Este es el reto:

Buscamos dos personas con conocimientos en programación y capaces de tener una visión global de cada proyecto, tanto front-end como back-end, con experiencia en .Net Core y SQL.

Entre otras cosas esto es lo que harías:

🚀 Creación de nuevos proyectos dentro del plan estratégico de transformación digital de la compañía:

· Entender las necesidades

· Trabajar con diseñadores gráficos para encontrar layouts atractivos y funcionales

· Traducir el diseño a código

· Creación y gestión de bases de datos

🚀 Mantenimiento y optimización de aplicaciones:

· Servicios Web

· Web APIs

· CRM

Habilidades y experiencia que necesitamos que tengas:
• Experiencia en entorno Visual Studio con lenguajes .Net C# y .Net Core
• Experiencia tanto en front-end como en back-end
• Experiencia en CSS, Javascript y HTML
• Experiencia en SQL
•... Conocimientos o experiencia en Git
• Conocimientos o experiencia en Azure preferiblemente, o cualquier otro entorno Cloud
• Conocimientos o experiencia en arquitecturas REST y SOAP
• Se valorarán conocimientos en:
• Angular
• React
• Typescript
• LINQ

Si te apetece el reto de demostrar que has nacido para programar y tienes ganas de aportar tus conocimientos a un equipo de trabajo con muchos retos e inquietudes, no lo dudes, ponte en contacto con nosotros y encontraremos la fórmula para que seamos felices disfrutando de nuestra pasión por la programación

jobs_results.title: .NET junior developer
jobs_results.description:
¿Quiénes somos? 🤗💙

¡Hola! Somos ARATECH Lifestyle Technology, una empresa con más de 10 años de experiencia, que nos especializamos en el reclutamiento y selección de diversos perfiles como son IT, Técnicos y Administrativos . El grupo de profesionales que trabaja en ARATECH tiene como misión ayudar a encontrar al mejor talento a nuestros clientes, trabajando junto a ellos a través de una colaboración estrecha.

¿Con quién trabajamos? 🤝🏢

Actualmente estamos trabajando junto con una empresa Start Up española. Nuestro partner desarrolla desde 1985 programas de contabilidad, software de gestión comercial y programa de nóminas. Situándose en posiciones lideres como fabricantes de software, su servicio de asesoramiento técnico destaca por la profesionalidad, rapidez y especialización que aseguran y garantizan a su herramienta como la idónea para las pymes españolas.

Juntos estamos buscando un .NET Developer que se incorpore a su equipo de Madrid.

¿Cuáles serán tus... funciones?📚📑

Tus tareas estarán relacionadas con labores de ampliación y mantenimiento de las actuales aplicaciones de gestión de escritorio en .NET/SQL Server

Requisitos:

¿Cuáles son las cosas que nos encantaría ver en ti?🤩🔍
• Formación Profesional o Grado Superior en Informática o algún otro tipo de estudios académicos relevantes para el desempeño del cargo.
• +1 año 1 y medio de experiencia programando en .NET
• Valoramos positivamente los conocimientos y experiencia en programas de gestión.
• Necesitamos que hables español nativo o fluido.

¿Qué ofrecemos?💙⭐
• 🏠Oficinas en Madrid.
• 🔆Modalidad Híbrida (2 días a la semana de teletrabajo). Después de algunos días presencial de formación
• 🕣Horario de oficina (9:00 a 18:00), y los viernes de 9 a 15.
• 💼Proceso de selección con 1 entrevista presencial
• 🤗Buen ambiente laboral.
• 🤝Contrato con cliente final de carácter indefinido

Juntos estamos buscando un .NET Developer que se incorpore a su equipo de Madrid.

¿Cuáles serán tus... funciones?📚📑

Tus tareas estarán relacionadas con labores de ampliación y mantenimiento de las actuales aplicaciones de gestión de escritorio en .NET/SQL Server

Requisitos:

¿Cuáles son las cosas que nos encantaría ver en ti?🤩🔍
• Formación Profesional o Grado Superior en Informática o algún otro tipo de estudios académicos relevantes para el desempeño del cargo.
• +1 año 1 y medio de experiencia programando en .NET
• Valoramos positivamente los conocimientos y experiencia en programas de gestión.
• Necesitamos que hables español nativo o fluido.

¿Qué ofrecemos?💙⭐
• 🏠Oficinas en Madrid.
• 🔆Modalidad Híbrida (2 días a la semana de teletrabajo). Después de algunos días presencial de formación
• 🕣Horario de oficina (9:00 a 18:00), y los viernes de 9 a 15.
• 💼Proceso de selección con 1 entrevista presencial
• 🤗Buen ambiente laboral.
• 🤝Contrato con cliente final de carácter indefinido

jobs_results.title: Full Stack Developer (.NET/React)
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work ™ .” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ® , offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion... think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram . Join our talent network to learn more about job opportunities and company news.

Who You Are

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Full Stack Software Developer with understanding the performance impact of clean code, multithreading, good UI design and scalability. You will find reward in building robust software that can function 24/7 with no down time. If you love technology, are passionate about creating software, SDK and APIs and are keen on contributing to open source projects - we would love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

As a Software Developer you will be part of a team that builds a state of the art IoT platform, that makes sense of the data collected by our custom built hardware connected to vehicle fleets. We receive detailed data and metrics for millions of vehicles globally, which is processed and interpreted to create actionable information for our customers. You will write high performance code using C#, .Net latest version and SQL queries to process and store this information in real-time.

How You'll Make An Impact
• Translate application storyboards and use cases into functional applications.
• Design, build, and maintain efficient, reusable, reliable code to develop high throughput, performance critical, scalable applications.
• Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.
• Perform Test Driven Development (TDD) by doing peer reviews, ensuring coding standards are followed, looking for logic errors and other bugs.
• Conduct code reviews and mentor junior team members.
• Provide proactive technical support to resellers, internal staff and customers.

What You'll Bring To This Role
• Bachelor of Computer Science, Electrical/Software Engineering or other related degrees.
• 5+ years of experience with C#/.Net and experience with object-oriented design, unit testing, optimization and multi threaded programming.
• Knowledge of other object oriented languages such as Java is an asset.
• Experience programming with Typescript or React, CSS and HTML.
• Experience with SQL database design, optimization and writing queries.
• Working knowledge of web services including REST and MVC.
• Working knowledge with Git and Jira is preferred.
• Knowledge of Cloud computing experience with GCP, AWS and/or Azure.
• Experience using Linux is a plus.
• Excellent verbal and written skills in English and Spanish is a must for this role.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.

What makes our staff passionate about Geotab?

Flex working arrangements

Home office reimbursement program

Fantastic state of the art office

Public transportation reimbursement

Employer pension contributions

Generous medical & dental benefits offered to you and family members

Electric vehicle purchase incentive program

Subsidized fitness membership

Co-pay tuition reimbursement
• The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only

How We Work

At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible first working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!

We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. Click here to learn more about what happens with your personal data
